title: Conversational search
content: Conversational search is a way of searching in which a person asks a question in full sentences, receives a written answer, and asks follow-up questions that build on it.

meta.why: A follow-up question builds on the earlier turn, and the second answer can draw on pages the opening question did not reach.
meta.example: A buyer asks about payroll software, then asks which of the named options handles contractors in two countries.
meta.check: Write the follow-up questions a buyer asks after the opening one and confirm your site answers each of them in plain text.
meta.limitation: The context sits in the earlier turns of the conversation, and the same follow-up typed alone can return a different answer.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: AI features and your website | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features | Platform documentation
